tools.name: list_trades
tools.description: List every industry (trade) PublicLeads sells business lists for, with the slug to pass to search_lists, plus the countries covered (US, Canada, Australia). Call this when the user's industry may not match a name directly.

tools.name: search_lists
tools.description: Find ready-made business contact lists for sale by industry and location. Returns up to 10 lists, best match first (the exact city, then its state/province, then the country): name, scope, number of businesses, how many have an email, price, and preview and buy links. tools.name: get_list_details
tools.description: Details of one list from search_lists: the fields included in the file, the price, the freshness policy, and a masked 5-row sample (business name, city, Google rating; emails and phones are masked). Pass the list value search_lists returned, or the list's publicleads.com URL.

tools.name: get_market_stats
tools.description: Aggregate statistics for an industry in a place: number of operational businesses, average Google rating, total reviews, and the percentage with an email, with a company-domain email, with a phone, with a website and with a street address. tools.name: request_custom_list
tools.description: When no ready-made list fits (an unusual industry, a county or a radius, several industries together), return the link to request a custom list and its price. We measure the data and reply with the real count before any payment.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_lists, get_list_details, get_market_stats · Private data: search_lists, get_list_details, get_market_stats · Public sink: search_lists, get_market_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_lists, get_list_details, get_market_stats · Private data: search_lists, get_list_details, get_market_stats · Public sink: search_lists, get_market_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
